children: According to U.S. officials, U.S. Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth is considering inviting hundreds of senior military officers to Marine Corps Base Quantico again this year to deliver remarks. One official said he is also expected to issue a new set of directives to the armed forces, while the timing of the meeting remains unclear and it is not known whether all active-duty generals and admirals will be called.

title: U.S. Defense Secretary May Again Gather Senior Military Officers at Quantico
